explanation: I found no Mathlib match. The theorem is entirely about the library's own definitions: `ExplicitPotential.CertificateData`, `Valid`, `FormsHold`, `subdivisionSpec`, `graphConnected` and `BNExists` (Brill–Noether existence for chip-firing divisors on graphs). Mathlib has no theory of Brill–Noether existence for graph divisors and no certificate machinery of this kind. The proof applies two of the library's own lemmas, `bnExists_of_valid_of_strongSeparator` and `SubdivisionGraph.Spec.coreVertices_strongSeparatorCertificate`, and uses no Mathlib result. I did not search Mathlib, because none of these concepts exist there.
